answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 151 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the island. The vine index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the umber queue while honest participants promoted earlier continues earning. That is 10 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
